<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that match the described forward reaction: broken functional groups are aromatic hydroxyls and ketones; formed functional group is ether oxygen; bonds formed are C-C and C-O; bond broken is C-O. This should return candidate templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C(C2=CC=CC=C2)C3=CC=CC=C3O1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aromatic hydroxyls", "ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
